question: Sudirman Cup is related to which of the following games?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Badminton.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The Sudirman Cup is the World Team Badminton Championships, held every two years.**
 
• The event was** first held in the Bung Karno Stadium,** Jakarta, Indonesia with 28 nations taking part.
 
• The Cup is named after **Dick Sudirman,** a former Indonesian badminton
